title: Splash 28 – The Best of Watercolor
description: Submit watercolor, gouache, casein, or egg tempera artwork for Splash 28. Open to artists worldwide aged 18 and above.
descriptionDetailed: Splash 28 invites contemporary watermedia artists to submit two-dimensional work in watercolor or similar water-based media such as gouache, casein, or egg tempera on paper. Acrylic is not accepted as the dominant medium, and AI-generated artwork is not considered. Winners earn cash prizes and are published in The Best of Watercolor, Summer 2027.

prize.description: 1st place $2,000, 2nd $1,000, 3rd $500. Ten honorable mentions receive a $50 gift card and a one-year Artists Network Membership ($99.99 value). Winners and 100+ finalists are published in The Best of Watercolor (Summer 2027).

audience.eligibilityLabel: Open to artists worldwide aged 18 and above
audience.eligibilityDetail: The dominant medium must be watercolor or a similar water-based medium (gouache, casein, or egg tempera) on paper. Acrylic is not acceptable as the dominant medium, and AI-generated artwork is not considered. Entries are limited to original two-dimensional works no deeper than 1.5 inches.
